GHSA-j88v-2chj-qfwx requires the non-default pgx simple protocol to be enabled. Harbor configures pgx via a standard DSN in src/common/dao/pgsql.go and never sets PreferSimpleProtocol or QueryExecModeSimpleProtocol, so the extended protocol (prepared statements) is always used and the dollar-quote placeholder confusion cannot occur.

The vulnerability requires ForwardToWall=yes in systemd-journald configuration to forward wall messages with ANSI escape sequences. Containers do not run systemd-journald, making this attack vector inapplicable.

CVE-2026-35172 affects the distribution registry blob storage layer when storage.cache.blobdescriptor uses redis and storage.delete.enabled is true, allowing revoked repo-local blob descriptor reads to return after peer-repo activity. Harbor jobservice does not run a distribution registry or its redis-backed blob storage backend. It uses the distribution/v2 library only as a client for manifest parsing and reference handling, so the vulnerable storage code path is never executed.

CVE-2026-33540 affects the distribution registry pull-through cache proxy authentication flow, where credentials can be sent to an attacker-controlled realm URL when an operator configures an upstream registry. Harbor jobservice does not run a distribution registry or its pull-through cache proxy. It uses the distribution/v2 library only as a client for registry interactions (manifest parsing, reference handling), so the vulnerable server-side proxy code path is never executed.

False positive. CVE-2026-22184 affects the untgz utility that is part of zlib source code, but Debian zlib packages (zlib1g and zlib1g-dev) do not ship the untgz utility by default. For Debian Trixie (and other versions), zlib comes from zlib1g (binaries) and does not include the untgz binary. The vulnerability scanner incorrectly flags zlib packages as vulnerable when the untgz utility is not actually present in the installed packages.
